experiments.label: Same new attention + Sampson + RL (PPO WRITE)

notes: Training budgets are unselected (null); supply explicit attention steps/epochs and PPO updates before executing fitting stages.
Both hybrid branches use exactly the same certified attention checkpoint per seed.
Both hybrid branches keep identical Sampson/RAFT, memory, preprocessing and frozen reconstruction settings; only WRITE policy changes.
Evaluation matches paper SCARED test8/9 at320x256, stride1; all branches must use identical manifest/frame IDs/seeds and camera/depth timing scope.
Dataset7 remains a patient-disjoint model-selection/certification holdout; this differs from paper training1-7 and is not the eight-dataset training recipe.
Released legacy uncertainty calls geometry_3d despite the paper describing Sampson; the original baseline is preserved and the discrepancy disclosed.
Published paper values are reference rows, not rerun measurements; no speedup against paper FPS without hardware/scope agreement.
